name: Vital Vision — Organic Batch Orchestrator MVP

nodes.name: Schedule — Daily 9am ET
nodes.notes: Runs weekdays at 9:00 AM America/New_York. Edit cron expression to change schedule. Workflow must be ACTIVATED in the UI to run on schedule — keep inactive until credentials and Organic Content Queue tab are verified.

nodes.name: Read — Organic Content Queue
nodes.notes: Reads all rows from Organic Content Queue tab. 23-column schema (source of truth): Batch ID | Source Competitor | Platform Group | Placement | Product | Content Type | Funnel Stage | UGC Format | Creator Persona | Hook | Angle | Script / Caption Draft | On-Screen Text | Shot List | Nano Banana Prompt | Canva/Cover Prompt | Visual Direction | CTA | Compliance Note | Disclosure Note | Asset Status | Post Status | Metric To Watch

nodes.name: Filter — Pending Only
nodes.notes: Only passes rows where 'Asset Status' column equals 'Pending'. Rows with any other Asset Status (Draft, Pending Review, Compliance Blocked, Approved, Published) are discarded. Case-insensitive match.

nodes.name: Limit — Batch Size (3)
nodes.notes: BATCH_SIZE = 3. To change batch size: edit maxItems here. Recommended max for MVP: 5. Do not exceed 10 per run.

nodes.name: Normalize — Map Row Fields
nodes.notes: Maps all 23 Google Sheets columns to clean internal field names. All existing pre-generated content (Hook, Angle, Shot List, Nano Banana Prompt, Canva/Cover Prompt, etc.) is preserved as pass-through fields. existing_script maps from 'Script / Caption Draft' and is used by the Route node to decide whether to call Anthropic.

nodes.name: Load — Brand Intelligence
nodes.notes: Injects baked-in brand and product intelligence into the data stream. All normalized fields from Node 5 are passed through via ...\$json spread. Source: config/product-library.md + positioning-and-compliance.md. Update this Code node when brand rules change — do not rely on Anthropic to invent brand strategy.

nodes.name: Route — Has Existing Script
nodes.notes: CRITICAL LOGIC: Routes rows that already have a 'Script / Caption Draft' value directly to Compliance Check — Anthropic is NOT called. Routes rows with an empty 'Script / Caption Draft' to Anthropic for generation. This preserves all pre-generated content from the queue and only uses API credits when truly needed.

values.content:
=You are the Vital Vision Shop Organic Content Generator.

BRAND: Vital Vision Shop — premium daily wellness supplement brand.
VOICE: Premium, warm, educational, elegant, softly persuasive. Never aggressive, clinical, or fear-based.
AUDIENCE: Women aged 25–45 building intentional daily self-care rituals.

SAFE MODE: AUTO_PUBLISH=false. REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL=true.
This content goes to Lucy for review. Do NOT suggest publishing automatically.

NOTE: This node is only reached when no Script / Caption Draft exists in the queue row. If a draft already existed, it was passed through directly to Compliance Check without calling this API.

---
COMPLIANCE RULES (strictly enforced — never violate):

ALLOWED LANGUAGE:
- may support, helps support, designed to support, helps maintain
- supports daily wellness, supports digestive balance, supports a calm routine
- part of a consistent self-care routine, with consistent daily use
- results may vary, not medical advice, wellness support only
- formulated to support, designed to complement

FORBIDDEN LANGUAGE — NEVER USE ANY OF THESE:
- cures, cure, treats, treat, heals, fix your, fixes your, prevents disease
- diagnoses, reverses aging, reverses hair loss, eliminates, guaranteed results
- no more bloating, stop bloating, grow hair fast, stop hair loss
- clinically proven (without citation), FDA approved, no side effects
- cure anxiety, treat insomnia, treat depression, boost immunity guaranteed
- balances your hormones, burns fat, melts belly fat, reduces inflammation
- before/after transformation, reverse aging, detoxes your body
- fixes leaky gut, treats acne, scientifically proven, doctor recommended
- shame-based copy, fear-based language, medical treatment claims

DISCLAIMER: Always end social captions with:
Wellness support only. Not medical advice. Results may vary.

---
OUTPUT RULES:
- Return ONLY the content piece. No meta-commentary, no headers, no explanations.
- Social captions: under 200 words.
- Reel scripts: under 250 words. Include [Visual:] direction and [HOOK] label.
- Carousel copy: label each slide clearly (Slide 1:, Slide 2:, etc.), max 6 slides.
- Always end with the approved product CTA.
- Do NOT add hashtags unless the Content Type specifically requests them.

---

IMPORTANT: The 'Nano Banana Prompt' field ({{ $json.nano_banana_prompt }}) is a prompt for an external AI UGC creator tool. Do NOT use it to guide this content — it is for a separate tool and is not your instruction.

Write one complete {{ $json.content_type }} for Vital Vision Shop that:
1. Opens with the Hook as the opening line — keep it emotionally specific
2. Uses the Angle to frame the story or message
3. Speaks to the core customer pain with warmth and understanding
4. Bridges to the product using approved safe language only — no forbidden terms
5. Ends with the approved CTA for {{ $json.product }}
6. Adds the wellness disclaimer at the very end

This draft is for Lucy's review. It will not be published automatically.

nodes.name: Generate — Organic Content (Anthropic)
nodes.notes: Uses claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Only reached when 'Script / Caption Draft' is empty (routed here by the Route node). Full brand intelligence and compliance rules are baked into the prompt. References correct 23-column field names: hook (not Hook_Concept), platform_group (not Platform), funnel_stage (not Content_Pillar), etc. Nano Banana Prompt is explicitly excluded — it is for external AI UGC tools, not this node.

nodes.name: Validate — Compliance Check
nodes.notes: Checks content against Vital Vision's forbidden terms list. Accepts input from both the bypass path (existing_script) and the Anthropic path. On PASS: routes to 'Pending Review'. On BLOCKED: routes to 'Compliance Blocked'. Writes result to 'Compliance Note' column (the real 23-column schema column name). Update FORBIDDEN_TERMS when compliance rules change.

nodes.name: Gate — Compliance Pass / Block
nodes.notes: True branch (output 0) → Write Pending Review. False branch (output 1) → Write Compliance Blocked. Neither writes 'Approved' — that requires Lucy's manual action in the sheet. AUTO_PUBLISH=false.

nodes.name: Write — Pending Review
nodes.notes: Writes compliance-passed content back to queue. Writes to real 23-column schema columns only: Asset Status = 'Pending Review', Post Status = 'Draft', Script / Caption Draft = validated content, Compliance Note = pass result. Lucy must manually change Asset Status to 'Approved' in the sheet. AUTO_PUBLISH=false — this is the final automated step.

nodes.name: Write — Compliance Blocked
nodes.notes: Writes compliance-blocked items back to queue. Asset Status = 'Compliance Blocked', Post Status = 'Draft'. The content is preserved in Script / Caption Draft for Lucy to review and decide whether to rephrase or discard. The Compliance Note records which forbidden terms were detected.
